name: The Workstation (browser UI for Claude Code)
description: Installs The Workstation web UI for Claude Code, optionally the Claude Code CLI, and autostarts the server on container start.

source.description: Where to get The Workstation. git: clone sourceUrl at 'version' and build. npm: npm i -g the package named by sourceUrl (default 'workstation') at 'version'. tarball: download a source tarball (e.g. a GitHub archive or release asset) from sourceUrl and build. local: use a bind-mounted checkout at localPath (built on first start if needed).

version.description: Git ref for source=git: a release tag (default) or, most reproducible, a full 40-char commit SHA (verified after checkout). Branches like 'main' float and are not recommended. npm version for source=npm (a leading 'v' is stripped). Ignored for tarball/local.

sourceUrl.description: git: repo URL (default https://github.com/VictorLazarov/the-workstation.git). npm: package name (default 'workstation'). tarball: tarball URL (required).

localPath.description: source=local only: absolute path inside the container where the checkout is mounted.

host.description: Bind address. 127.0.0.1 (default) works with VS Code / Codespaces port forwarding, which connects via localhost inside the container. Use 0.0.0.0 only when publishing the port with 'docker run -p' / appPort; the server is then reachable from the network (token-gated).

autostart.description: Start the server in the background on every container start. The sign-in URL (with token) is written to $WORKSTATION_HOME/url (0600); run 'workstation-url' to print it.

printUrl.description: Also print the tokenized URL in the postStartCommand output. Off by default because those logs are often shared; 'workstation-url' prints it on demand.

installClaudeCode.description: Also install the Claude Code CLI globally (pinned to claudeCodeVersion) for terminal use and 'claude login'. Off by default: the Agent SDK bundles its own runtime.

claudeCodeVersion.description: Exact @anthropic-ai/claude-code version installed when installClaudeCode is true (default: the version bundled by the Agent SDK this release uses). Ranges and dist-tags are rejected.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js major version installed (official nodejs.org tarball, SHA256-verified) if Node >= 20 is not already present. Prefer adding ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node.
